newsitem.title: CHINA: China to decide on new overseas listings this year.
newsitem.headline: China to decide on new overseas listings this year.

text.p: China will decide by the end of this year on the fourth group of firms to be listed abroad, a senior official of the China Securities Regulatory Commission was quoted on Wednesday as saying.

The Shanghai Securities News quoted Li Xiaoxue, head of the commission's department for foreign listings, as saying that there were many rumours about the names of the firms but that all these were false.
Work on preparing the list was continuing and it should be completed by the end of 1996, Li said.
He said that H share companies would be allowed to issue convertible bonds but gave no timetable or further details.
Beijing has approved three groups of firms to issue shares abroad, in markets including Hong Kong, New York and Singapore.
